result.topic_en: Calculations on the one-dimensional gas-flow equations in Riemann-invariant form for a spherically symmetric (radius r) wave, including a change to characteristic coordinates m, n, derivation of second-order equations for p and q, the hodograph-type inversion with the Jacobian Δ, and special cases such as p = -q.
result.transcription:
$\frac{\partial p}{\partial t}+(u+a)\frac{\partial p}{\partial r}=2\frac{au}{r}$
$\frac{\partial q}{\partial t}+(u-a)\frac{\partial q}{\partial r}=2\frac{au}{r}$
$dp=\frac{dp}{dr}(dr-(u+a)dt)+\frac{2au}{r}dt$
$dq=\frac{dq}{dr}(dr-(u-a)dt)+\frac{2au}{r}dt$
$dr-(u+a)dt=\mu dm=-2a\frac{\partial t}{\partial m}dm$
$dr-(u-a)dt=\nu dn=2a\frac{\partial t}{\partial n}dn$
$2a\,dt=\nu dn-\mu dm$
$2a\,dr=(u+a)\nu dn-(u-a)\mu dm$
$\frac{dp}{dn}=\frac{2au}{r}\frac{dt}{dn}=\frac{2au}{u+a}\frac{d\log r}{dn}$
$\frac{dq}{dm}=\frac{2au}{r}\frac{dt}{dm}=\frac{2au}{u-a}\frac{d\log r}{dm}$
$\frac{1}{r}\left(\frac{\partial(r\frac{dp}{dn})}{\partial m}-\frac{d\,r\frac{dq}{dm}}{dn}\right)=\frac{\partial^2p}{\partial m\partial n}-\frac{\partial^2q}{\partial m\partial n}+\frac{\partial p}{\partial n}\frac{\partial q}{\partial m}\left(\frac{u-a}{2au}-\frac{u+a}{2au}\right)=0$
$\frac{\partial^2p}{\partial m\partial n}-\frac{\partial^2q}{\partial m\partial n}-\frac{1}{a}\frac{\partial p}{\partial n}\frac{\partial q}{\partial m}=0$
$\frac{\partial((u+a)\frac{\partial p}{\partial n})}{\partial m}-\frac{\partial((u-a)\frac{\partial q}{\partial m})}{\partial n}=0=(u+a)\frac{\partial^2p}{\partial m\partial n}-(u-a)\frac{\partial^2q}{\partial m\partial n}+\frac{1}{2}\left(\frac{\partial p}{\partial m}\frac{\partial p}{\partial n}-\frac{\partial q}{\partial n}\frac{\partial q}{\partial m}\right)$
$dp=\frac{dp}{dm}dm+\frac{dp}{dn}dn=\frac{dp}{dm}dm+\frac{2au}{r}\frac{dt}{dn}dn$
$-\frac{dp}{dr}2a\frac{dt}{dm}=\frac{dp}{dm}-\frac{dq}{dm}=-\frac{1}{a}\frac{\partial p}{\partial\log r}\frac{dq}{dm}$
$\frac{dq}{dr}2a\frac{dt}{dn}=\frac{dq}{dn}-\frac{dp}{dn}=\frac{1}{a}\frac{\partial q}{\partial\log r}\frac{dp}{dn}$
$\frac{dp}{dm}=\left(1-\frac{1}{a}\frac{\partial p}{\partial\log r}\right)\frac{dq}{dm}$
$\frac{dq}{dn}=\left(1+\frac{1}{a}\frac{\partial q}{\partial\log r}\right)\frac{dp}{dn}$
$4a\frac{\partial^2p}{\partial m\partial n}+\frac{\partial p}{\partial m}\frac{\partial p}{\partial n}-\frac{\partial q}{\partial n}\frac{\partial q}{\partial m}+2\frac{u-a}{a}\frac{\partial p}{\partial n}\frac{\partial q}{\partial m}=0$
$4a\frac{\partial^2q}{\partial m\partial n}+\frac{\partial p}{\partial m}\frac{\partial p}{\partial n}-\frac{\partial q}{\partial n}\frac{\partial q}{\partial m}+2\frac{u+a}{a}\frac{\partial p}{\partial n}\frac{\partial q}{\partial m}=0$
$p=\nu+\mu\quad q=\nu_1+\mu_1$
$\frac{\partial^2}{\partial m\partial n}=0$ [-...-] $\frac{\partial p}{\partial n}:\frac{\partial q}{\partial m}-\frac{\partial q}{\partial n}:\frac{\partial p}{\partial m}+2\frac{u-a}{a}=0$
$\mu':\mu_1'-\nu_1':\nu'+\frac{\mu+\mu_1}{a}+\frac{\nu+\nu_1}{a}-2=0$

$dn=\frac{\partial n}{\partial p}dp+\frac{\partial n}{\partial q}dq\quad \Delta dp=\frac{\partial m}{\partial q}dn-\frac{\partial n}{\partial q}dm$
$dm=\frac{\partial m}{\partial p}dp+\frac{\partial m}{\partial q}dq\quad \Delta dq=-\frac{\partial m}{\partial p}dn+\frac{\partial n}{\partial p}dm$
$\frac{\frac{\partial^2p}{\partial m\partial n}}{\frac{\partial p}{\partial n}\frac{\partial q}{\partial m}}=\frac{\partial\log\frac{\partial p}{\partial n}}{\partial m}\Big/\frac{\partial q}{\partial m}=-\frac{\partial\log\frac{\partial p}{\partial n}}{\partial p}\frac{\frac{\partial n}{\partial q}}{\frac{\partial n}{\partial p}}+\frac{\partial\log\frac{\partial p}{\partial n}}{\partial q}$
$=-\frac{\partial\log\frac{\partial m}{\partial q}}{\partial p}\frac{\frac{\partial n}{\partial q}}{\frac{\partial n}{\partial p}}+\frac{\partial\log\frac{\partial m}{\partial q}}{\partial q}+\frac{\partial\log\Delta}{\partial p}\frac{\frac{\partial n}{\partial q}}{\frac{\partial n}{\partial p}}-\frac{\partial\log\Delta}{\partial q}$
$\Delta=\frac{\partial m}{\partial q}\frac{\partial n}{\partial p}-\frac{\partial n}{\partial q}\frac{\partial m}{\partial p}\quad\frac{\partial n}{\partial q}\frac{\partial\Delta}{\partial p}=\left(\frac{\partial^2m}{\partial p\partial q}\frac{\partial n}{\partial p}-\frac{\partial^2m}{\partial p^2}\frac{\partial n}{\partial q}\right)\frac{\partial n}{\partial q}+\left(\frac{\partial m}{\partial q}\frac{\partial^2n}{\partial p^2}-\frac{\partial m}{\partial p}\frac{\partial^2n}{\partial p\partial q}\right)\frac{\partial n}{\partial q}$
$-\frac{\partial n}{\partial p}\frac{\partial\Delta}{\partial q}=+\left(\frac{\partial^2m}{\partial p\partial q}\frac{\partial n}{\partial q}-\frac{\partial^2m}{\partial q^2}\frac{\partial n}{\partial p}\right)\frac{\partial n}{\partial p}+\left(\frac{\partial m}{\partial p}\frac{\partial^2n}{\partial q^2}-\frac{\partial m}{\partial q}\frac{\partial^2n}{\partial p\partial q}\right)\frac{\partial n}{\partial p}$
$-\left(\frac{\partial^2m}{\partial p\partial q}\frac{\partial n}{\partial q}-\frac{\partial^2m}{\partial q^2}\frac{\partial n}{\partial p}\right)\left(\frac{\partial n}{\partial p}-\frac{\frac{\partial m}{\partial p}}{\frac{\partial m}{\partial q}}\frac{\partial n}{\partial q}\right)$
$\partial p=-\partial q$

$\frac{\partial p}{\partial n}=\alpha\frac{\partial q}{\partial n}$
$\frac{\partial q}{\partial m}=\beta\frac{\partial p}{\partial m}$
$\frac{\partial^2p}{\partial m\partial n}=\alpha\frac{\partial^2q}{\partial m\partial n}+\frac{\partial q}{\partial n}\left(\frac{\partial\alpha}{\partial p}\frac{\partial p}{\partial m}+\frac{\partial\alpha}{\partial q}\frac{\partial q}{\partial m}\right)=\alpha\frac{\partial^2q}{\partial m\partial n}+\frac{\partial q}{\partial n}\frac{\partial p}{\partial m}\left(\frac{\partial\alpha}{\partial p}+\beta\frac{\partial\alpha}{\partial q}\right)$
$\frac{\partial^2q}{\partial m\partial n}=\beta\frac{\partial^2p}{\partial m\partial n}+\frac{\partial p}{\partial m}\left(\frac{\partial\beta}{\partial p}\frac{\partial p}{\partial n}+\frac{\partial\beta}{\partial q}\frac{\partial q}{\partial n}\right)=\beta\frac{\partial^2p}{\partial m\partial n}+\frac{\partial q}{\partial n}\frac{\partial p}{\partial m}\left(\frac{\partial\beta}{\partial p}\alpha+\frac{\partial\beta}{\partial q}\right)$
$(1-\alpha\beta)\frac{\partial^2q}{\partial m\partial n}=\frac{\partial q}{\partial n}\frac{\partial p}{\partial m}\left(\beta\frac{\partial\alpha}{\partial p}+\beta^2\frac{\partial\alpha}{\partial q}+\frac{\partial\beta}{\partial p}\alpha+\frac{\partial\beta}{\partial q}\right)$
$(1-\alpha\beta)\frac{\partial^2p}{\partial m\partial n}=\frac{\partial q}{\partial n}\frac{\partial p}{\partial m}\left(\frac{\partial\alpha}{\partial p}+\beta\frac{\partial\alpha}{\partial q}+\alpha\frac{\partial\beta}{\partial q}+\alpha^2\frac{\partial\beta}{\partial p}\right)$
$4a\frac{\partial^2q}{\partial m\partial n}=\frac{\partial p}{\partial m}\frac{\partial q}{\partial n}\left(-2\frac{u+a}{a}+\beta-\alpha\right)$
$4a\frac{\partial^2p}{\partial m\partial n}=\frac{\partial p}{\partial m}\frac{\partial q}{\partial n}\left(-2\frac{u-a}{a}+\beta-\alpha\right)$
$4a\left(\frac{\partial\alpha}{\partial p}+\beta\frac{\partial\alpha}{\partial q}\right)=\left(-2\frac{u}{a}+\beta-\alpha\right)(1-\alpha)+2(1+\alpha)$
$4a\left(\frac{\partial\beta}{\partial q}+\alpha\frac{\partial\beta}{\partial p}\right)=\left(-2\frac{u}{a}+\beta-\alpha\right)(1-\beta)-2(1+\beta)$

methods.what: Characteristic (Riemann-invariant) form of spherically symmetric isothermal gas flow
Introduction of characteristic coordinates m, n
Variation of p and q along characteristics in terms of log r
Compatibility (cross-differentiation) condition giving second-order equation in m,n
methods.quote: $\frac{\partial^2p}{\partial m\partial n}-\frac{\partial^2q}{\partial m\partial n}-\frac{1}{a}\frac{\partial p}{\partial n}\frac{\partial q}{\partial m}=0$

methods.what: Second-order system for p and q in characteristic coordinates
methods.quote: $4a\frac{\partial^2p}{\partial m\partial n}+\frac{\partial p}{\partial m}\frac{\partial p}{\partial n}-\frac{\partial q}{\partial n}\frac{\partial q}{\partial m}+2\frac{u-a}{a}\frac{\partial p}{\partial n}\frac{\partial q}{\partial m}=0$

methods.what: Trial with separable sums p=ν+μ, q=ν1+μ1
Inversion (hodograph-type) with Jacobian Δ, m,n as functions of p,q
methods.quote: $\Delta=\frac{\partial m}{\partial q}\frac{\partial n}{\partial p}-\frac{\partial n}{\partial q}\frac{\partial m}{\partial p}$

methods.what: Ansatz relating derivatives via α, β and resulting first-order PDEs for α, β
Ansatz linear in t: p=π+ςt, q=χ−ςt, giving ODE for u(r)
Steady solution r as function of u
Steady case relations for dp, dq
Case p=−q (u=0): reduction to Liouville-type equation linearized by exponential, general solution
